messages:
Morgan H: Heads-up: planning a short maintenance for rack cohort az24-east-2c tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. Thermal spikes after load test; we'll do controlled cooldown + soft drains.
Sanjay P: Which pools and user impact?
Morgan H: pool-gpu-highmem-3 (primary), pool-gpu-standard-7 (backfill). Expect ~10% capacity dip in that AZ. No API downtime; route to other AZs.
Ellie R: Run a 2-node canary for KV reseed timing? Last was ~180ms p99.
Morgan H: Canary at 02:00, cohort ramp at 02:10. Abort if reseed p99 > 400ms.
Rafa: Disable scheduled batch jobs to those pools from 01:50-04:30 pls.
Lena: I'll add scheduler exclusions.
infra-oncall-bot: Playbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/playbooks/rack-thermal. Auto-page if >5% host failures in 5m.
Sanjay P: Dedicated tenants pinned? Need comms.
Morgan H: @acct-neo and @acct-cerebro pinned. SEs notified; offer burst to us-east-1 if needed.
Ellie R: Drain snippet:
```
kubectl drain node-<id> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --pod-selector='app!=critical' --grace-period=120
```
Lena: I'll run monitor and enable extra dashboards.
Rafa: Cost: burst => ~1.4x unit cost for window (finance ok).
Sanjay P: Shift low-priority embeddings to batch-west to save burst cost?
Morgan H: Agree. Move jobs tagged "priority:low". Lena, coordinate with Batch SRE.
Lena: Pinging @batch-sre.
infra-oncall-bot: rolling-drain-script v2.3.1 scheduled at 02:00 (https://ci.redwood/builds/8723).
Ellie R: I'll watch canary; abort if chat p95 +50ms.
Lena: Canary started (02:00). Draining node-az24-07 & -09.
Rafa: Temps dropped ~12% after fan ramp.
Ellie R: Canary reseed p99=210ms, p95 +18ms. OK.
Morgan H: Ramp at 02:10. Staggered 5-node batches, 5m gap.
infra-oncall-bot: cohort-ramp batch-2 started (02:15).
Lena: Batch-2 drained; KV backfill in us-east-1 underway.
Sanjay P: Small spike in 5xx (~0.3%). Watching.
Ellie R: Transient expected; monitoring traces.
Rafa: Final batch in progress; fan RPMs normalized.
Morgan H: 40m in; temps down ~22%. No rollback.
infra-oncall-bot: Status page notice scheduled at 01:30 UTC.
Lena: Rejoin sequence started. No reboots needed.
Sanjay P: Postmortem items: KV timings, customer latency, burst cost.
Morgan H: I'll create ops note and metrics. Closing after PM link. :white_check_mark:
